$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

67:72.name: Card Frame
67:72.description: The constant frame (POSTCARDS.md §1). Only the Content Zone changes between cards. Accent rail and tick bind to type/accent: set the instance's Post Type mode to set the type. Series posts show Day and Series ("21 DAYS OF DEV"); regular posts turn both off. Swap Content to a Content/* archetype. Judge at 320px (Thumbnail Test page).

67:70.name: Content/Empty
67:70.description: Default content for Card Frame. Swap the frame's Content property to a Content/* archetype.

29:28.name: Sheet
29:28.description: The paper sheet a web page sits on: the card stock's tall cut, Imagery/Paper 2:3, stretched over tertiary-container, pinned to the Light scheme (the paper is a light raster). Desktop: an 800px column, a 4px on-secondary border, 20/24/16 padding. Mobile (below 640px): full width, 16px padding, no border. Put the page into Content; children stack 20px apart. .lk-sheet.

29:35.name: Stage
29:35.description: A full-bleed web backdrop: Imagery/Palm Sky, cover, over primary-container. Desktop centres its Page 32px from the top with 16px sides; Mobile runs the page edge to edge. Holds a Sheet. .lk-stage.
